title: one physical future head + Mirror future-offset views
hypothesis: When future-offset teachers share one output matrix under low-dimensional hidden-space Givens transforms, one physical MTP head plus offset-specific Mirror coordinates can recover the independently parameterized heads with lower actual serialized model bytes; on unaligned offset heads, it should fail or require private residuals.
physical_object: one shared future-token output projection over a common frozen trunk representation
mirror_coordinate: per-future-offset Givens angles applied to the shared hidden vector before the shared output head
logical_multiplicity: four offset-specific output functions from one output matrix
teacher: four categorical future-offset distributions from a shared teacher output matrix with per-offset Givens rotations; a second mode uses independently sampled offset matrices as a structural negative control

task.metric: teacher-to-student categorical KL and top-1 distribution agreement

controls: tied head plus per-offset scalar logit gates
tied head plus per-offset rank-1 output residual
one shared head plus Mirror Givens views
ordinary MTP is the independent-head quality upper control

development.selection_metric: mean teacher-to-student KL over methods and modes

storage.authority: actual serialized full inference model payload bytes
storage.serialization: torch.save state_dict plus deterministic config JSON
paid_objects: all output heads or shared head

success_gate: In all three fresh aligned worlds, Mirror teacher-KL <=1.10x ordinary MTP, offset top-1 agreement >=99%, and full model payload <=0.75x ordinary MTP. It must improve the quality/byte frontier over hard tying, scalar gate and rank-1 residual. The independent-offset condition is a registered negative control, not required to pass.
failure_gate: Mirror misses any aligned quality gate in two or more fresh worlds, or a simpler tied/gate/low-rank method matches its quality with equal or lower actual payload. Report independent-mode failure as the point where private offset parameters are needed.
boundaries: synthetic frozen features, not a language model
teacher aligned mode is an optimistic mechanism test

protocol_amendments.reason: The preregistered <=0.40 full-payload ratio was incompatible with the paid common feature trunk and serializer overhead: the shared trunk is charged identically to all methods and imposes a substantial fixed byte floor.
protocol_amendments.change: Set the full-model payload threshold to <=0.75x MTP, still requiring at least 25% actual serialized byte reduction. Preserve all methods, seeds, rates, updates and quality gates.
